allow: PowerShell(Get-Command cortex-hook -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-List Name,Source; Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\\.cortex\\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Length,LastWriteTime)
PowerShell($h=$env:USERPROFILE; Write-Output "USERPROFILE=$h"; Test-Path "$h\\.cortex"; Test-Path "$h\\.claude\\settings.json"; Get-Command cortex-hook 2>$null)

PowerShell(where.exe cortex-hook 2>&1 ; "---" ; Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\\.cortex" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, Length, LastWriteTime ; "---" ; Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\\.claude\\settings.json")
